title: Custom provider upstream port is lost or rejected by Squid
symptoms: Configured Ollama port 11434 is routed to port 80
Trusted API-proxy custom-port request is rejected as an unsafe port
conditions: An operator configures a provider URL with an explicit non-default HTTP or HTTPS port
The request originates from the trusted API-proxy sidecar and the exact configured host/port is authorized; agent-origin custom-port denial remains expected
rootCause: Older provider target handling discarded explicit ports. Preserving the port also requires an exact trusted-sidecar Squid exception; broad Safe_ports changes would incorrectly change agent policy.

probe.expect: Compare the generated exact destination/port ACLs with the redacted operator configuration; inspect no provider credentials, raw URLs or request headers.

action: Use source containing end-to-end scheme/port/base-path preservation and exact API-proxy-source host/port ACLs, then regenerate configuration. Keep Safe_ports, dangerous-port rejection, agent isolation, destination blocklists and DLP unchanged. A denial from an untrusted source or mismatched host/port is not this regression.

references.title: Trusted LLM service routing keeps the sidecar upstream exact and proxy-only
Azure Foundry target shares the exact custom-port sidecar upstream path
resolveApiProxyUpstreams() emits custom-port and trusted-service proxyOnly upstreams
Trusted service admits only the proxy source to the exact HTTPS service
